name: EXDATE and RDATE: remove one occurrence and add another
note: A daily 09:00 series from Monday 2026-02-02 bounded by UNTIL=20260205T140000Z generates Feb 2, 3, 4 and 5, each at 14:00Z (EST, UTC-5). EXDATE removes Feb 3. RDATE adds Feb 6 at the same local time, which UNTIL does not bound because RDATE is outside the rule's own count. The expected set is therefore Feb 2, Feb 4, Feb 5 and Feb 6, ascending; the added Feb 6 sorts last because the expansion is ordered by instant, not by rule source.
